title: Provisional Ballot Status Navigator
tagline: Status assistance must be exact, private, official, and strictly nonpartisan.

cards: A voter needs a clear answer from an official record.
Only the designated system can establish status and next steps.
A helpful agent can become partisan or expose private voter data.
The navigator protects privacy, access, and election-official authority.

story.headline: The ballot-status answer that guessed eligibility
beats: A voter asks whether a provisional ballot was counted.
The receipt, jurisdiction, official status, and possible cure notice are separate.
Guessing from registration facts can misstate status or eligibility.
The nonpartisan ledger reports only official state and routes the election office.
